source.title: Topology of real analytic sets - Some open problems

trace.notes: Input normalized as one URL. The zbMATH document id 3805710 was identified as J. Bochnak, "Topology of real analytic sets - Some open problems", with DOI 10.1007/BFb0062256 and pages 212-217 in Lecture Notes in Mathematics 959.

The zbMATH URL functioned only as a bibliographic resolver in this environment. A local shell attempt to access the zbMATH API failed with DNS/network resolution unavailable, and web-accessible zbMATH surfaces exposed metadata rather than full technical text.

The Springer landing page for the containing book confirmed the same chapter title, author J. Bochnak, and pages 212-217, but the page states that the book is subscription preview content and does not expose the chapter problem statements.

Bounded exact-work recovery searched by DOI, exact title plus PDF, exact title plus author, and Lecture Notes in Mathematics 959 PDF. Candidate surfaces found were Springer, Open Library, ISBN/bookseller/catalog pages, and an institutional ebook record; they were rejected because they were metadata/catalog pages, restricted access records, or did not contain the readable chapter text.
